name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: At the hidden shrine in Ashenvale, Raene's Cleansing reaches a turning point. The Rod of Transformation is assembled and its magic restored, and you must return it to Shael'dryn at her moonwell sanctuary.

sections.title: A Restored Relic
sections.body: At the hidden shrine in Ashenvale, you have restored the Rod of Transformation. Its shaft, pommel, and glowing gem are joined, and the rod has been re-enchanted. Shael'dryn needs it for Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks.

sections.title: Return to Shael'dryn
sections.body: Shael'dryn waits beside the forest moonwell, where she has guided the rod's restoration. You bring her the finished relic and confirm its magic has returned. Then the Sentinel defenders can take their next steps to protect their besieged homeland.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this stage of the quest?
faq.answer: You have assembled the Rod of Transformation at the hidden shrine. Return it to Shael'dryn, who waits at the moonwell in northern Ashenvale.

Shael'dryn is a dryad who tends a sacred moonwell in Ashenvale. She works to cleanse the ancient forest of spreading corruption and directs trusted allies to gather relics, purify components, and restore sacred artifacts.
Shael'dryn waits at a quiet moonwell in northern Ashenvale, east of the main road between Astranaar and Felwood. The tranquil waters are in her care.

faq.q: What is the Rod of Transformation?
faq.answer: The Rod of Transformation is Dartol's magical creation. Its restored power is meant to help Raene investigate the furbolgs; the form it grants is discovered later.

faq.q: Why is assembling the rod so important to Astranaar?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner hopes the rod will let an investigator approach the furbolgs and learn more about the attacks threatening Astranaar.

faq.q: Does assembling the rod end the cleansing chain?
faq.answer: No. Shael'dryn next asks you to return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar and tell her the rod is finished.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, restoring the rod helps Raene investigate the furbolg attacks threatening Astranaar and the surrounding groves.
As an Alliance member, securing Ashenvale matters to your standing in northern Kalimdor and helps protect Astranaar from local corruption and hostile forces.
As a priest, you help Shael'dryn restore a magical relic Raene needs for her investigation in Ashenvale.
